subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should Telegram opt into the new public `captionedFinalText` capability by default, making non-tagged final-mode TTS a single captioned voice message despite the separate-delivery preference tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539?
rationale: Tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot choose the permanent Plugin SDK contract or the default user-facing Telegram delivery policy.

options.title: Adopt capability and bundled default
options.body: Accept the additive capability, keep Telegram opted in, require current-head proof, and leave separate delivery as a distinct follow-up product request.

options.title: Keep capability internal to Telegram
options.body: Narrow the repair to a Telegram-owned implementation and defer the public Plugin SDK contract until more channels need it.

options.title: Require selectable delivery
options.body: Expand the work to support an explicit bundled-versus-separate user preference, accepting the additional configuration and upgrade surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt capability and bundled default
recommendation.body: Accept the additive capability, keep Telegram opted in, require current-head proof, and leave separate delivery as a distinct follow-up product request.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and PR timeline make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-cutting Plugin SDK and Telegram default-UX choice.
